title: Draconic Totems
description: Draconic Totems adds a new totem that works infinitely but runs off emeralds
body: **Draconic Totems** adds an insane totem that works **Infinitely** but it runs off emeralds as fuel. However the crafting recipe is **extremely complex** and needs tons of material to make it. and once aquired, if you have enough emeralds you are practically **Immortal**
